standard: NIST SP 800-193 Platform Firmware Resiliency Guidelines

clauses.title: Firmware update authentication
clauses.body: All firmware updates shall be authenticated by verifying a digital signature over the update image using a public key rooted in a trusted key store. Authentication shall occur before the update is applied. Rollback protection shall prevent installation of older, vulnerable versions unless explicitly authorized.

clauses.title: Root of trust for update
clauses.body: The platform shall include a Root of Trust for Update (RTU) — immutable or protected code and data that authenticate firmware updates. The RTU shall be protected against unauthorized modification for the life of the platform.

clauses.title: Platform integrity detection
clauses.body: The platform shall detect corruption of firmware code, firmware data, and critical platform configuration. Detection may occur at boot time, at runtime, or through periodic integrity verification, and shall be reported to a management interface.
